items.q: He encouraged Nebraskans to vote early by mail or by delivering their ballot to dropboxes located outside of county offices.

record.t: Lost the Republican primary for Nebraska Secretary of State to Scott Petersen while serving as the incumbent.
record.q: Scott Petersen (R) defeated incumbent Bob Evnen (R) in the Republican primary for Nebraska Secretary of State on May 12, 2026.

record.t: Won re-election as Nebraska Secretary of State in the general election.
record.q: Incumbent Bob Evnen (R) won election in the general election for Nebraska Secretary of State on November 8, 2022.

record.t: Said Nebraska voters would receive an early voting request form by mail, to be returned to county election officials by May 1, 2020.
record.q: He said that Nebraska voters will receive an early voting request form by mail, which needs to be filled out, signed, and sent in to county election officials by May 1, 2020 to receive an early voting ballot.

record.t: Was sworn in as Nebraska Secretary of State on January 10, 2019.
record.q: Secretary Evnen, was sworn in as the 27th Secretary of State of Nebraska, on January 10, 2019.

record.t: Assumed office as Nebraska Secretary of State on January 10, 2019, with the current term ending January 7, 2027.
record.q: Bob Evnen (Republican Party) is the Nebraska Secretary of State. He assumed office on January 10, 2019. His current term ends on January 7, 2027.

record.t: Was elected Nebraska Secretary of State, defeating Spencer Danner in the general election.
record.q: Bob Evnen (R) defeated Spencer Danner (D) in the general election for Nebraska Secretary of State on November 6, 2018.

record.t: Confirmed that Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Cindy Burbank was removed from the 2026 ballot after the Nebraska Republican Party filed a complaint.
record.q: Democrat Cindy Burbank will no longer be in the running for the Senate seat, Secretary of State Bob Evnen, a Republican, confirmed to the Nebraska Examiner on Tuesday.

record.t: Approved the ballot measure on using public money for private school tuition after the petition gathered more valid signatures than needed.
record.q: The number of valid signatures gathered far exceeded the number needed, and Nebraska Secretary of State Bob Evnen approved the ballot measure.

record.t: Confirmed that Democratic Senate candidate Cindy Burbank was removed from the ballot after the Nebraska Republican Party filed a complaint with his office.
record.q: The Nebraska GOP filed a complaint to Evnen’s office, alleging Burbank was not a “good-faith candidate,” ultimately prompting her removal from the ballot.

record.t: Said his office had received reports of anonymous phone calls telling voters to stay home, and told Nebraskans to ignore them.

record.t: Confirmed that polling sites would be open for in-person voting on Election Day in May.
record.q: Secretary Evnen confirmed that polling sites will be open for Nebraskans who prefer to vote in-person on Election Day in May.
